info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-Replace Healthcare Appointments Reschedule-v2-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Rescheduling API is designed to facilitate the rescheduling of existing patient appointments within the healthcare system. It enables healthcare providers to easily update appointment details, ensuring that patients receive timely care according to their changing needs. This API primarily serves healthcare administrators and scheduling personnel who require an efficient mechanism to manage appointments. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their patient management processes, improve resource allocation, and streamline administrative workflows.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to reschedule an existing appointment by providing the necessary details. Ensure that the new time and date are valid and do not conflict with existing appointments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for rescheduling an appointment. Ensure all required fields are included to successfully update the appointment's date, time, or other relevant information.

200.description: The appointment has been successfully rescheduled.
